description: Ministry of Higher Education - Notify the Amendment of the specified Authority Rules No. 01 of  22.08.2013
reasoning: This gazette content contains amendments to rules under the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978, specifically dealing with the regulatory framework for recognizing institutes as degree-awarding institutions. It modifies legal procedures, processing fees, and compliance requirements, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure categories.
